title: The flats at 2127-2129 Prairie are built
items: The three-storey brick flats at 2127-2129 Prairie, on the east side near 22nd Street, now stand in full in place of their rough model. The 1911 map gives the plan: two buildings of flats side by side behind one front, a door for each at the middle, and an open three-storey porch at the back. No picture of it is known, so the red brick front, arched doorway, cornice and porch are a careful best guess, and the building's card says so. The corner lot next door, 2141, stays open ground, as the map shows it.
